temporal_state_chain.observed: Carolyn observes that Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn for several days, which is out of character. When Carolyn asks if she is alright, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed by work and personal stuff and thanks her for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn is normally engaging and that her recent quietness may mean something is wrong, but she does not yet know the cause.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn confirms that she is overwhelmed by work and personal issues, which explains the withdrawal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is dealing with work and personal stress and may need support; Carolyn's concern was appropriate.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, sympathetic, and willing to listen.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer support and keep the door open for Marilyn to talk if she wants.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After Carolyn's initial approach, Marilyn responds curtly in a later interaction, leaving Carolyn confused and hurt. When Carolyn shares her own tough experiences and asks if she overstepped, Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes if she seemed off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After Scenario 1, Carolyn believes Marilyn is overwhelmed by work and personal stress and that her offer to listen was well received.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's curtness first makes Carolyn think she may have overstepped or that Marilyn is upset with her; Marilyn's later apology and explanation reframe the behavior as due to Marilyn's hard week, not rejection.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn appreciates Carolyn's support and was simply having a hard time; the misunderstanding is eased.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially confused and slightly hurt, then relieved and reassured, with continued empathy.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue showing support, respect Marilyn's boundaries, and maintain open communication.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responds positively to Carolyn's openness, accepts Carolyn's invitation to a small weekend get-together, and says she would love to join.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes she and Marilyn have begun to resolve the earlier awkwardness and are building a friendship; she feels relieved and hopeful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's enthusiastic acceptance confirms she is interested in a social friendship outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn reciprocates the friendship, and their bond appears to be strengthening.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Host the get-together and deepen her friendship with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn observes that Marilyn still keeps a professional distance at the bank. When Carolyn raises this directly, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes if it seemed that way, and agrees to talk about improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After Scenario 3, Carolyn believes their friendship is growing and feels hopeful about the bond, though she has not yet addressed their work dynamic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Carolyn's perception of professional distance makes her disappointed and uncertain, but Marilyn's surprise and willingness to talk suggest the distance may be unintentional or unperceived rather than a rejection.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The work distance may not be intentional; Marilyn is open to discussing and improving their professional collaboration, though details still need to be worked out.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed, then cautiously reassured and hopeful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Talk through their work dynamic, clarify professional expectations and personal boundaries, and improve collaboration.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn agrees to team up on the new project proposal, says she is glad they had the talk, and looks forward to working more closely with Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Following the private meeting, Carolyn believes they have resolved the work-distance issue and now understand each other's expectations and boundaries; she feels content and optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's agreement and positive response confirm that she also values the improved understanding and wants to collaborate closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn and Marilyn have a clearer, more positive professional relationship and can partner effectively on the new project.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up with Marilyn on the new project proposal and further their partnership.
